title: Refill the autonomous backlog from current system gaps
summary: Replenish the durable autonomous backlog after every prior seed template was consumed, using current live coverage, status, and roadmap gaps as the source of truth.
expectedFailureModes: The continuation loop stops because every backlog template already has a task file.
New task templates are chosen from chat context instead of durable status and coverage evidence.
Agents treat backlog exhaustion as a blocker even though unblocked system hardening work remains.
nextAction: Integrated; run the continuation loop and seed the next refreshed backlog task.
